relations.subject: William Howell
relations.evidence: When 14 apprenticed as Assistant Surveyor in Madras Survey under Major Mackenzie, conducted surveys in the South and in 1818 followed Mackenzie to Calcutta

relations.subject: William Howell
relations.evidence: From 1821 working for London Missionary Society from 1821. First in Bellary as superintendent of native schools, in 1822 started mission in Cuddapah (Kadapa)... In 1842 left the mission

relations.subject: William Howell
relations.evidence: In 1842 left the mission and joined the Church of England  working as priest in Madras until his retirement in 1856.
